body:
This fixes a bug in the `infiniteHits` widget where the `isLastPage` value could conflict with the cached state.

## Reproduction

Assume you have an `infiniteHits` widget with a `pagination` widget (which can happen when you want better SEO).

1. Click page 3
2. Click page 1
3. Click "Show more results"
4. Notice you're on page 4 which doesn't exist

[See reproduction →](https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearchjs-infinitehits-page-bug-pyd4v)

## Fix

We now don't rely only on the helper state but also on the cached state. If the last page has been cached in the `infiniteHits` cache, we consider `isLastPage` to be `true`.
